build.note: the matches replay exactly only on this build (the port and website/capture as of this commit; the bots, the trace, the screenshot window)
build.configure: python configure.py --release; ninja linux_x86_64 (x86-64 Linux, the 5900x)

scout.moments: moments.json (each moment: match spec, seed, exact kill tick, chain first/last, kind)

previews.notes: previews/NN-*.json (the window each was filmed in, its kills)

commands: tools/shoot.py scout-nx --count 16 --per-kind 8 --only 13,08 --size 3840x2160 --out clips-4k (copied into final-scout/clips-4k as 41 and 42)
master.note: --only's numbers need the previews' --count and --per-kind to name the same moments; --moments numbers from 31

cut.note: a beat runs from before a chain's first kill to after its last: each multi-kill shown whole
cut.changes: the first cut had eight shots; three dropped (two unzoomed snipes, a second Damnation rocket), a Warthog splatter added to open, the magnum triple swapped for Sidewinder's (it looked mechanical); then two rocket shots (Prisoner, Hang 'Em High) swapped for a needler on Prisoner and a sticky on Hang 'Em High: six shots on six maps

web.encode: hero-web/encode.sh: 1280, 1920 and 2560 wide at 1.6, 3.2 and 5.5 Mbit/s, H.264 and two-pass VP9, a keyframe each second; the poster the first frame
